Siamo un'azienda italiana di gioielleria Made in Italy. Nel 2027 avviamo un piano di crescita che riguarda prodotto, brand e distribuzione, con un forte focus sull'estero. Cosa farai Analizzerai i mercati esteri e, partendo dalle ipotesi già formulate dall'azienda, confermerai o rivedrai la scelta dei 2-3 Paesi prioritari, valutando potenziale, concorrenza, posizionamento di prezzo e barriere d'ingresso. Gestirai il budget export e definirai gli obiettivi di fatturato, margine e numero di nuovi clienti. Cercherai, selezionerai e attiverai distributori, agenti e punti vendita qualificati, negoziando i contratti e seguendo direttamente i clienti chiave. Gestirai le fiere internazionali e gli incontri con i buyer. Riporterai a prodotto e marketing le indicazioni dei mercati su collezioni, fasce di prezzo e materiali di comunicazione e vendita. Obiettivi Entro 2 mesi presenterai il piano export alla direzione. Requisiti Almeno 5 anni nell'export in gioielleria, orologeria o accessori di lusso e fashion. We create innovative and sustainable solutions for our customers to answer society’s needs – today and in the future. We are looking for team members who bring ideas forward, champion others and work together to do better. Does that sound like you? About the job As Business Development Manager Textile EMEA, you will be a sales-driven commercial leader, accountable for the profitable growth of our textile business across the Surfactants, CMC and Chelates product lines. You will own the sales number for your territory and deliver it through key customers and, above all, through a strong network of distributors: selecting, developing, motivating and steering distribution partners to win market share, widen our customer base and protect margin. You will combine a hunter’s drive for new business with disciplined account and distributor management, working closely with Technical Service, R&D and Marketing across the EMEA region. In addition, you will be responsible for managing the Expancel business in Italy, including the distributor. A proven sales background in chemicals for textile – surfactants, wetting agents, antifoams and thickeners – is a must for this role. In your future role as Business Development Manager Textile you will •    Own and deliver sales, revenue and margin targets for the Textile segment in your territory, with full accountability for budget, forecast and results. •    Lead distribution management: select, onboard, develop and steer distributors; agree annual business plans, sales targets, terms and incentives; and review their performance (sell-in, sell-out, stock, margin) on a regular basis. •    Grow sales through distributors: run joint customer visits, share and follow up leads, review pipelines together and ensure coverage of mills, dyehouses, finishers and formulators; identify white spaces and appoint or replace distributors where needed. •    Train and coach distributor sales and technical teams on products, applications and value propositions, enabling them to sell with confidence and win against competition. •    Manage and grow key accounts – mills, brands, formulators and converters – building long-term relationships at purchasing, technical and management levels. •    Hunt for new business: identify, qualify and convert new customers, applications and segments in textile processing, finishing and adjacent markets, and build a strong pipeline from lead to order. •    Lead commercial negotiations on pricing, contracts, rebates and supply agreements, safeguarding profitability and aligning with business strategy. •    Develop and execute account and distributor plans; coordinate customer trials with Technical Service and R&D to turn technical wins into repeat sales. •    Monitor market trends, competitor activity and pricing, translating insights into sales actions and strategic recommendations. •    Drive accurate sales forecasting, opportunity management and CRM discipline to support effective business planning. •    Manage the Expancel business in Italy, including the distributor. •    Collaborate with cross-functional teams and represent Nouryon at industry events, trade shows and customer meetings to expand our position in the textile market. We believe you bring •    Must have: proven sales background in chemicals for textile applications – specifically surfactants, wetting agents, antifoams and thickeners (e.g. alkoxylates, CMC and other polymers, chelating agents). We believe you are •    A commercially driven sales professional with strong negotiation and closing skills, able to create customer value while delivering profitable growth. •    A proactive business developer with a hunter mentality who enjoys identifying new opportunities, opening doors and converting prospects into long-term business. •    A natural channel manager and relationship builder, able to motivate and steer distributors and build trust with customers and stakeholders at all levels. •    Technically curious and able to translate technical capabilities into customer value. •    Entrepreneurial and results-oriented, with the ability to manage opportunities and projects from idea to successful implementation. •    Analytical and data-driven, using sell-out, pipeline, market and margin data to steer distributors and customers and turn insights into actionable plans. •    Well-organized and self-motivated, with strong planning and prioritization skills and the ability to balance short-term results with long-term growth initiatives. •    An effective communicator and presenter who can engage both technical and commercial audiences with confidence. •    A collaborative team player who thrives in an international environment and combines a high level of ownership, accountability and drive with strong cross-functional cooperation. Identify and structure new business and demand creation opportunities; support design activity and conversion into revenue. Drive commercial discussions with our direct or POS customers (working via our distribution network) and ensure disciplined follow-up and execution. Plan and coordinate activities within assigned local projects/workstreams, together with involved management and stakeholders. Track milestones, evaluate progress, and support final acceptance of deliverables where applicable. Strong commercial mindset, negotiation skills, and ability to manage multiple stakeholders. Structured, proactive, customer-oriented approach; hands-on mentality and high accountability. Strong communication skills in English; Italian fluency is expected. Willingness to travel mainly within Italy. Good knowledge of CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce) and standard business software (MS Office). Invia un messaggio diretto all’autore dell’offerta di lavoro da Aira Elena Cutrupi Elena Cutrupi As Senior Paid Media Specialist, you’ll run the paid acquisition engine behind Aira’s growth across our European markets. Working day to day with our paid media agencies, you’ll plan, build and optimize campaigns across Search, Social, Display and Native, and drive results against CPL, CAC and lead quality. This is a hands-on global role in the Global Marketing team, reporting to the Head of Growth Marketing and based in Lainate (Milano). About Aira 10% of Europe’s CO₂ emissions are caused by residential heating, and energy bills are out of control. Aira is here to change that. With our intelligent Aira Heat Pump at the heart, we’re making the switch to clean energy-tech easier and more affordable. Helping Europe turn off gas and slash energy costs, one home at a time . Founded in 2022, and with 1,000+ employees and counting, Aira is driving the clean energy revolution by providing homes with modern clean energy-tech solutions, including heat pumps, solar power and battery storage . With a state-of-the-art production facility in Poland , headquarters in Stockholm, Sweden , and hubs across the UK, Germany and Italy , Aira is on track to bring clean energy-tech to every home. Find out more about us on our website . The role We’re looking for a Senior Paid Media Specialist based in Lainate (Milano) to help us scale customer acquisition across Aira’s markets. You’ll report to the global Head of Growth Marketing and have global scope . This is a hands-on role at the centre of our lead acquisition engine . You’ll work with our paid media agencies to build, run and optimize campaigns, keep our ad accounts healthy on every platform we use, and help us test and scale new ones. You’ll also support landing pages and creative, working with our creative agency to turn insights into better-converting experiences. Your work will have a direct impact on the growth of our customer base and revenue, and will be fundamental to Aira’s ambition of becoming the leader in clean energy solutions. What You'll Do Run our acquisition with our agencies. Work day to day with our paid media agencies to plan, build, launch and optimize campaigns across Paid Search, Paid Social, Display and Native. Review performance, challenge assumptions and make sure campaigns are built and run to the highest standard. Manage budgets and drive results against CPL, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC) and lead quality. Support performance of our affiliate partners. Keep our platforms healthy. Own the health of our ad accounts on every platform we run. Audit account structure, conversion tracking, bidding and audience setup, follow up on platform recommendations and health reports, and make sure the signals we send support profitable growth. Test and scale new channels. Explore, test and scale new platforms and channels, building the test plan, defining success criteria and making clear scale or stop decisions. Improve landing pages and creative. Build, test and optimize landing pages in our CMS to improve conversion. Work with our creative agency on briefs, ad concepts and creative testing, and bring performance insights back into the creative process. Turn data into decisions. Use HubSpot, Excel and AI tools to create and maintain reports and dashboards, automate recurring analysis and surface insights faster. Track key performance metrics and support budgeting and forecasting. What You'll Bring To The Role 2-4 years of experience in an agency or in an ad operations role, with hands-on campaign building. Strong experience with Google Ads, Meta Ads and Native Ads, including campaign setup, optimization and account audits. Solid knowledge of conversion tracking (GA4, Google Tag Manager or similar). Strong analytical skills and experience turning campaign data into clear recommendations, with comfort using AI tools to speed up analysis and reporting. Experience building or optimizing landing pages and working with creative teams or agencies. Advanced Microsoft Excel skills. Excellent written and spoken both Italian and English, as you’ll work with colleagues and partners across several markets. Preferred experience in: building AI agents; Microsoft Ads, TikTok or LinkedIn; HubSpot and a headless CMS such as Strapi What's In For You Salary range: €36,000 - €40,000 gross per year; permanent contract. Hybrid working policy and a yearly welfare budget. Collaboration with a diverse, international team and the opportunity to see your work come to life across multiple channels and European markets. The chance to shape how a growing clean energy brand reaches homeowners, making an important and complex topic more accessible, engaging and relevant. The opportunity to contribute to a fast-growing scale-up with a dynamic, solution-oriented culture. Our hiring process : intro call - interview with the Head of Growth Marketing - interview with another member of the Global marketing team - final interview with the Global marketing director.
